decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted 2nd May 2017 and numbered 01/06 and 03/06, and submitted 10th May 2017 and numbered 02/06, therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Erection of a single storey rear in-fill extension, renewal of roof to existing single storey side extension and fenestration changes to the front elevation incorporating the erection of a porch to dwelling house.
